description: We are TechVerse, a team passionate about technology, space exploration, and innovation. summary:
ASTROBASE: MISSION CONTROL is an interactive 3D lunar exploration and astronaut training simulation designed to make space science engaging and accessible. Players take the role of lunar mission trainees and explore a simulated Moon research outpost featuring 16 facilities, astronaut operations, rover exploration, scientific experiments, mission objectives and contextual quizzes.

The application combines immersive 3D environments with guided, step-by-step missions to introduce concepts such as lunar navigation, life-support systems, EVA safety, low-gravity physics, resource management and space research. An AI-powered astronaut assistant, ARIA, provides explanations and learning support throughout the experience.

Built using Google AI Studio, the project aims to transform complex lunar exploration concepts into an interactive educational experience that encourages curiosity, scientific understanding and problem-solving.
details:
ASTROBASE: MISSION CONTROL

ASTROBASE: MISSION CONTROL is an interactive 3D lunar exploration and astronaut training simulation designed to help users learn about lunar science, space engineering, and astronaut operations through an engaging virtual environment.

Players take the role of an astronaut exploring a simulated lunar research outpost. They can navigate between 16 research facilities, complete guided missions, operate a lunar rover, participate in educational experiments and facility quizzes, and learn about Extravehicular Activity (EVA) safety procedures. The simulation also includes astronaut movement, navigation and radar interfaces, mission objectives, and an AI-powered astronaut assistant called ARIA, which helps explain lunar science and the facilities.

The project aims to make space science and lunar exploration more accessible, interactive, and educational. Instead of only reading about astronaut activities, users can experience simulated lunar operations, understand the purpose of different research facilities, and learn through practical activities and challenges.

The creative aspect of ASTROBASE is its combination of 3D exploration, astronaut training, educational challenges, rover operations, and an AI-powered assistant in one connected lunar research environment. It transforms complex space science topics into interactive learning experiences.

The project was developed using React, TypeScript, Three.js, Google AI Studio, and the Google Gemini API. NASA lunar resources, including the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter Camera (LROC), Lunar Orbiter Laser Altimeter (LOLA), and Diviner Lunar Radiometer Experiment, are referenced to support the lunar science and exploration experience.

During development, important considerations included educational value, usability, navigation, interaction design, realistic lunar exploration concepts, and making the experience engaging for users. The project also considers the importance of explaining scientific concepts clearly and helping users understand astronaut safety procedures and lunar research operations.

The intended impact of ASTROBASE is to encourage interest in space exploration, promote STEM education, and help students and the public understand the science, technology, and challenges involved in future lunar missions.
